EGY.note: QR check of a voter's number is not stated to be an ID authentication service.
Nothing on operation or ownership of the ID system.

facts.fact: Egypt's National Elections Authority says it updated the voter lists for the 2025 Senate election with a QR code beside each voter's name to verify the correctness of his national number.

systems.platform: QR code read by presiding judge's app

EGY.note: Nothing on the ID system itself.
